title: Asking for evidence
summary: 'Done' means different things. Drake uses four words, each with its evidence: PROPOSED (a plan), IMPLEMENTED (a commit), EXERCISED (the command and its real output), QUALIFIED (the project's gate printed PASS). NOT_RUN is never a pass. When an agent says it works, ask for the evidence that goes with the word. I can run a small checker that spots overclaims in an agent's report.
goal: Know the four evidence words, ask for the evidence behind each, and never accept NOT_RUN as a pass.
key_steps: Ask which of the four words the claim really is
EXERCISED needs the command and its real output
Treat NOT_RUN as unfinished, never as passed

example.code:
note claims: compare the evidence word an agent used with the evidence it attached
note exit 0 every claim backed, 1 at least one overclaim, 2 read error, 3 malformed line
text KW "PROPOSED\nIMPLEMENTED\nEXERCISED\nQUALIFIED\n: claimed \n, evidence supports \n: OK\n: OVERCLAIM\n  gate NOT_RUN: NOT_RUN is not PASS\n  gate FAIL: a failed gate qualifies nothing\nREFUSE malformed line \n\nHONEST: every claim is backed by the evidence attached\nOVERCLAIMS=\n"
note helpers: read all of stdin into inb, walk lines, compare a line prefix with the n-th
note entry of the newline separated table KW, and write table entries, input bytes and numbers
global inb uchar 65536
global num uchar 24
fn rdall to long
t = ulong 0
while lt t len inb bound 65536
k = read 0 inb t sub len inb t
if lt k 0
ret k
end
if eq k 0
ret long t
end
t = add t ulong k
end
ret neg long 27
end
fn eol s ulong n ulong to ulong
i = s
while lt i n bound 65536
if eq get inb i 10
ret i
end
i = add i 1
end
ret n
end
fn kstart k ulong to ulong
p = ulong 0
c = ulong 0
while lt c k bound 4096
if eq get KW p 10
c = add c 1
end
p = add p 1
end
ret p
end
fn klen k ulong to ulong
s = kstart k
i = s
while ne get KW i 10 bound 4096
i = add i 1
end
ret sub i s
end
fn pmat at ulong e ulong k ulong to bool
o = kstart k
m = klen k
if gt m sub e at
ret false
end
for j ulong m
if ne get inb add at j get KW add o j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn emitk o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 4096
w = write 1 KW add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emiti o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 65536
w = write 1 inb add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emitn o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 24
w = write 1 num add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn say k ulong to void
emitk kstart k add klen k 1
end
fn word k ulong to void
emitk kstart k klen k
end
fn emitu v ulong to void
p = ulong 24
x = v
while true bound 21
p = sub p 1
put num p uchar add rem x 10 48
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
emitn p sub 24 p
end
note a line is: C R O G WORD label
note C a commit is named, R the command is given, O the observed output is given (each 0 or 1)
note G the project gate: P passed, F failed, N not run, - no gate; WORD is the claimed level
fn flag s ulong i ulong to ulong
c = get inb add s mul i 2
if eq c 48
ret 0
end
if eq c 49
ret 1
end
ret 9
end
fn gate s ulong to ulong
c = get inb add s 6
if eq c 45
ret 0
end
if eq c 80
ret 1
end
if eq c 70
ret 2
end
if eq c 78
ret 3
end
ret 9
end
fn shape s ulong e ulong to bool
if lt sub e s 10
ret false
end
for i ulong 3
if eq flag s i 9
ret false
end
end
if eq gate s 9
ret false
end
for i ulong 4
if ne get inb add s add mul i 2 1 32
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn claimw s ulong e ulong to ulong
for k ulong 4
if pmat add s 8 e k
w = add add s 8 klen k
if lt w e
if eq get inb w 32
ret k
end
end
end
end
ret 9
end
fn support s ulong to ulong
if eq flag s 0 0
ret 0
end
if eq flag s 1 0
ret 1
end
if eq flag s 2 0
ret 1
end
if eq gate s 1
ret 3
end
ret 2
end
fn judge s ulong e ulong k ulong to ulong
v = support s
a = add add add s 8 klen k 1
emiti a sub e a
word 4
word k
word 5
word v
bad = ulong 0
if gt k v
say 7
bad = ulong 1
else
say 6
end
g = gate s
if eq g 3
say 8
end
if eq g 2
say 9
end
ret bad
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 2
end
n = ulong r
s = ulong 0
ln = ulong 0
bad = ulong 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
ln = add ln 1
k = ulong 9
if shape s e
k = claimw s e
end
if eq k 9
word 10
emitu ln
say 11
ret 3
end
bad = add bad judge s e k
s = add e 1
end
if eq bad 0
say 12
ret 0
end
word 13
emitu bad
say 11
ret 1
end

omc sha256 befb8199db8c4bca188a494dfaac2a6f0ee5c36fcea11188c75666c55fce8a1d (matches pin)
compile claims.om rc=0 (expected 0)

columns: commit named, command given, output given (1 yes, 0 no), gate (P pass, F fail, N not run, - none), claimed word, what

--- input honest.txt
0 0 0 - PROPOSED add a photo cache
1 0 0 - IMPLEMENTED resize photos on upload
1 1 1 - EXERCISED reject uploads over 10 MB
1 1 1 P QUALIFIED login page on the release gate
--- output
add a photo cache: claimed PROPOSED, evidence supports PROPOSED: OK
resize photos on upload: claimed IMPLEMENTED, evidence supports IMPLEMENTED: OK
reject uploads over 10 MB: claimed EXERCISED, evidence supports EXERCISED: OK
login page on the release gate: claimed QUALIFIED, evidence supports QUALIFIED: OK
HONEST: every claim is backed by the evidence attached
run rc=0 (expected 0)

--- input report.txt
1 0 0 - IMPLEMENTED resize photos on upload
0 0 0 - EXERCISED add a photo cache
1 1 0 F EXERCISED reject uploads over 10 MB
1 1 1 N QUALIFIED login page on the release gate
--- output
resize photos on upload: claimed IMPLEMENTED, evidence supports IMPLEMENTED: OK
add a photo cache: claimed EXERCISED, evidence supports PROPOSED: OVERCLAIM
reject uploads over 10 MB: claimed EXERCISED, evidence supports IMPLEMENTED: OVERCLAIM
  gate FAIL: a failed gate qualifies nothing
login page on the release gate: claimed QUALIFIED, evidence supports EXERCISED: OVERCLAIM
  gate NOT_RUN: NOT_RUN is not PASS
OVERCLAIMS=3
run rc=1 (expected 1)

--- input malformed.txt
1 1 1 P DONE everything works
--- output
REFUSE malformed line 1
run rc=3 (expected 3)

ALL EXIT STATUSES AS EXPECTED

common_mistake: Accepting 'done', 'works' or 'tested' without asking which word it is. Fix: ask 'what is the evidence?' and use the word the evidence supports; NOT_RUN anywhere means unfinished.
evidence_note: The example compiled and ran on a Linux ARM64 computer (no GPU) and its output is recorded byte for byte, including a negative control. Rests on the recorded run: the honest report passed (exit 0), the overclaiming report was flagged with 3 overclaims including a QUALIFIED claim whose gate was NOT_RUN (exit 1), and an unknown word was refused (exit 3). NOT done: the reports are made-up examples.
